critical_code_review_comments: Forbidden-word policy is enforced in MULTIPLE source-of-truth layers (static JSX copy + seeded Mongo entries + seeded books). A future rename pass should grep both /app/frontend/src AND the seed/admin data — only updating JSX leaves DB-driven titles stale (this is what bit /library/adults this iteration).

Strong recommendation: add a CI lint rule (simple regex over `frontend/src/**/*.{js,jsx}`) that fails the build on unescaped occurrences of /\b(system|protocol|interface|module|agent|chatbot|structure)s?\b/i — would have caught 6 of the 7 leaks above before review.

Consider extracting the Instagram block into a single component (it appears to be inlined into multiple pages) — current leakage suggests either copy-paste duplication or a shared component whose copy was not updated. Either way, one prop/string would replace 5 page edits.
AiDock paragraph rewrite is clean and successful — the new text reads naturally and stays within the directive.

rca of the issue: Three independent sources of leak: (1) shared Instagram block whose heading copy ('Follow us for Matrix Protocols.') was not part of this iteration's rename — leaks to 5 pages because the block is inlined on each. (2) Seeded Mongo content (library entries + books collection) was not updated alongside the JSX rename — Library.jsx now maps `kindMeta.protocol → 'Reading'` for the kind label but the entry/book TITLES themselves still contain the literal word. (3) Learning.jsx renamed the eyebrow + entry top label + per-track count successfully, but the track DESCRIPTIONS and per-entry description blurbs ('Introductory modules.', 'The opening module.') were missed. Reproduction: navigate to any of the 6 affected routes and ctrl-F for 'protocol' or 'module' in rendered text. Mitigation: see the action_items list — 6 P0 edits + 1 P1 edit (structure on /the-beginning).
